_about: Settings for the fact sheets (engine/profiles/: build.py, walk_grid.py, fetch_walk.py, fetch_drive.py, page.html): one per ZIP code (the map's units; Dallas has no official neighborhoods). 'The subway' here is DART light rail (dart_stations, dart_lines); stops and changes to the hubs are counted along each drawn line, with a change wherever two stations sit within 200 m. The headline transit time is the map's own To downtown (zip_profiles.json 'downtown'). Regional rail is the Silver Line and the TRE (rail_stations). Parking rows are EV charging only (parking.geojson, from cities/dallas/parking.py). factsheet.css colours the line bullets in DART's colours (cities/dallas/city.css).
